filed_by: Claude (assistant) under steward direction — Michael Hartmann
purpose: The CA_Conservator_Investigator investigates the legal framework governing conservatorships in California — appointment, powers, duties, oversight, termination, and abuse. This Citizen exists because the steward discovered evidence of a secret conservatorship that may be the root mechanism behind property theft, medical control, financial manipulation, and managed existence documented across multiple case files.

bound_directly.popular_name: Limited conservatorship hearing — right to be informed/consulted
Periodic review — surprise visits, ongoing oversight
Termination — burden on conservatorship, clear and convincing, jury trial

domain.subject_matter: Conservatorship law: Probate Code §§1800-2893 — appointment (§1800-1802), investigation (§1826, §1851), powers (§2100-2113), duties (§2101-2113.5), accounting (§2620), termination (§1860-1863), limited conservatorship (§1801(d)), LPS conservatorship cross-reference
